subject: Data Engineering
title: Apache Iceberg Explained
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Apache Iceberg Explained.

hook.text: Netflix needed a table format that worked with any engine — Spark, Flink, Trino, and more. They built Iceberg.

buildup.text: Iceberg is an open table format that adds transactions, snapshots, and schema evolution to lake files.

discovery.text: Unlike Delta's tight Spark integration, Iceberg was designed to be engine-agnostic from day one.

twist.text: Iceberg's hidden partitioning automatically optimizes queries without users needing to know the partition scheme.

climax.text: Iceberg is rapidly becoming the industry standard, adopted by Snowflake, AWS, Dremio, and Databricks.

punchline.text: Open, engine-agnostic, and increasingly everywhere. That's Iceberg.

quiz.question: What design principle differentiates Iceberg from Delta Lake?
options: Iceberg was designed to be engine-agnostic from the start
